full_judgment:
7. Mr. Serajul Islam, the learned Senior Advocate appearing on behalf of the petitioners, submits that the prima-facie title and possession was clearly found by the learned Assistant Judge in favour of the plaintiffs but this was not properly controverted by the Appellate Court, as such, the judgment of the Appellate Court was not a proper judgment of reversal which was not addressed to by the High Court Division. Besides, he submits that the learned Judge of the High Court Division illegally held that the cause of action of the suit was not proved although threatening and attempting to dispossess the plaintiffs are both stated in the plaint as well as the witness on behalf of the plaintiffs stated so. 

 1) Whether the judgment of the Appellate Court is a proper judgment of reversal in respect of the factum of claimed possession of the plaintiffs and their attempted dispossession by the defendants which ought to have been considered by the learned Ridge of the High Court Division.
